Passwords — shown this once; channels.json keeps only their hashes:
  orga       uby6-q9x9-mczm
  Casters    zaqm-d95z-xeev
  Orga Room  6fk9-yr58-d7uk

Restart the server to load it. To change a password for good, put
"password": "…" in place of that channel's "password_hash".

- Posting in an announcement channel takes an admin (the admin token) or, on a server with accounts, a moderator.
- Teams can open more rooms with +; for a big event raise max_channels in server_settings.json.
- Need more matches at once? Copy a pair of Match rooms and number them on.
